title: Chief Technical Officer (CTO)
description:
- Lead technical strategy and oversee the development of AI-powered products, SaaS applications, and intelligent automation solutions.
- Architect and develop scalable software systems, web applications, and data-driven platforms.
- Drive the integration of AI and machine learning technologies into practical, business-focused products.
- Oversee technology selection, system architecture, development workflows, and software quality.
- Guide product development from ideation and prototyping to implementation and deployment.
- Align technical decisions with business objectives, product scalability, and long-term growth.
